rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but includes some speculative image-specific details (e.g., quadrant location of ICM, zona comments, partial collapse artifact) without clear support.
Strong integration of age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, smoking, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, first-cycle status, and embryo grade into overall prognosis.

Reasoning is mostly logical and the probability estimate is tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor inconsistency appears in discussing fresh transfer/freeze-all considerations without full supporting data.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: supports eSET, cautions against routine add-ons, and appropriately frames PGT-A as optional at age 34. Minor overreach in suggesting freeze-all may be preferable for endometriosis without case-specific indication.

Provides clear practical steps for current transfer and future planning, including smoking cessation, luteal support review, eSET, and when to consider further workup or PGT-A; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
